outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow, not a plot of data.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows individual data points (dots, n=4) overlaid on each bar.
Tumor volume plot displays individual data points for each mouse, with mean and 95% CI overlaid.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression (shRNA) shows individual data points overlaid on each bar.
This is a line plot showing tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Quantification bar chart for CD4 intensity displays individual data points for each field/tumor overlaid on the bars.
Quantification bar chart for pERK intensity displays individual data points for each field overlaid on the bars.
